title_zh: 5499 元起，vivo X500 系列发布
content_zh:
vivo 昨日发布 X500 系列，包括 X500、X500 Pro 和 X500 Pro Max。现场价格信息显示，X500 起售价 5499 元，X500 Pro 起售价 6499 元，X500 Pro Max 起售价 6999 元。

X500 Pro Max 采用 6.85 英寸 2K LTPO 直屏、天玑 9600 Pro 和 8000mAh 电池，支持 90W 有线及 40W 无线充电。影像方面，它配备 1/1.28 英寸 LYT-L910 主摄和 2 亿像素 85mm 潜望长焦，支持 4K 240 帧慢动作、Log 和全焦段 4K Live。

X500 的机身重量为 211 克，内置 7500mAh 电池，同样配备潜望长焦和无线充电，处理器为天玑 9600M。全系搭载 OriginOS 7，引入可在多个应用之间整理信息的「原子工作台」。

🔗 相关阅读：vivo X500 系列首发评测：影像旗舰的下一步，不只一张好照片
title_en: vivo Launches X500 Series Flagships Starting at 5,499 Yuan
content_en:
vivo has officially unveiled its latest flagship smartphone lineup, the vivo X500 series, comprising the X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max. Pricing starts at 5,499 RMB (~$760 USD) for the standard X500, 6,499 RMB for the X500 Pro, and 6,999 RMB for the top-tier X500 Pro Max.

The premium X500 Pro Max boasts a 6.85-inch 2K LTPO flat display and is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. It features a massive 8,000mAh battery supporting 90W wired and 40W wireless fast charging. On the imaging front, it sports a 1/1.28-inch LYT-L910 main sensor alongside a 200-megapixel 85mm periscope telephoto lens, supporting 4K 240fps slow-motion, Log recording, and full-focal-length 4K Live video.

The standard X500 weighs 211 grams and packs a 7,500mAh battery. It also includes a periscope telephoto lens and wireless charging, powered by the Dimensity 9600M processor. The entire lineup runs on OriginOS 7, introducing the "Atomic Workbench" feature to help users seamlessly organize information across multiple applications.

title_zh: 小米 18 Pro 系列新增硬件级智能防窥，支持按应用和场景设置
content_zh:
小米昨日公布了小米 18 Pro 系列智能防窥屏的更多细节。「超级像素屏幕 2.0」在屏幕中交错排布普通像素和防窥像素，防窥像素两侧的微结构会限制侧面可视角度；开启功能后，普通像素关闭，只点亮防窥像素。

系统允许用户按应用和界面类型分别设定防窥范围，包括 App 通知、小窗、分屏和锁屏通知。用户也可将 AI 键设为一键开启全局防窥，或通过超级小爱按地点和应用组合设定规则，例如到公司后开启社交应用防窥、回家后关闭。

全局防窥还可从控制中心快速开关。小米 18 Pro 系列定于 9 月 23 日 19:00 发布。
title_en: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series to Feature Hardware-Level Smart Privacy Screen
content_en:
Xiaomi has revealed details about the advanced privacy screen technology coming to the upcoming Xiaomi 18 Pro series. Utilizing "Super Pixel Screen 2.0," the display interleaves standard pixels with specialized privacy pixels. Microstructures on the sides of these privacy pixels restrict lateral viewing angles. When the privacy mode is activated, standard pixels are turned off, leaving only the privacy pixels active to prevent onlookers from snooping.

The system offers highly customizable privacy settings. Users can define privacy zones based on specific applications and interface elements, such as app notifications, floating windows, split-screen views, and lock screen alerts.

Additionally, the physical AI button can be mapped to toggle global privacy mode instantly. Users can also automate the feature using the Super Xiao Ai assistant to create location- and app-based rules—for instance, automatically enabling privacy for social media apps at the office and disabling it at home. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series is scheduled for official release on September 23.

title_zh: 影石 Luna Ultra 更新：最高 22.5 倍变焦，新增 4K 竖拍
content_zh:
昨日，影石 Insta360 宣布为旗舰云台相机 Luna Ultra 推出长焦与人像功能升级，并同步上线演唱会超长焦套装。

其中，Luna Ultra 搭配全新增距镜后，最高可实现 22.5 倍变焦和 450mm 等效焦距；机内最高变焦倍率则由 12 倍提升至 15 倍，对应 300mm 等效焦距。演唱会超长焦套装包含 Luna Ultra、增距镜和收纳包，国内售价 4358 元。

针对演唱会场景，Luna Ultra 新增舞台模式，并强化暗光长焦追踪能力；人像功能方面，本次更新新增 4K 超清竖拍、竖拍照片、电影感实况和美颜实况，可直接生成适合手机观看和社交平台分享的竖屏内容。

此外，新增的「拍录一体」功能允许用户在持续录像过程中同时拍摄实况照片，无需中断视频；收音方面则提供舞台收音和全场收音两种模式，分别侧重舞台方向声音和现场环境声。
title_en: Insta360 Luna Ultra Update Adds 22.5x Zoom and 4K Vertical Shooting
content_en:
Insta360 has announced a major firmware update for its flagship gimbal camera, the Luna Ultra, introducing enhanced telephoto and portrait capabilities alongside a new "Concert Super-Telephoto Kit."

With the new teleconverter accessory, the Luna Ultra can now achieve up to 22.5x zoom (a 450mm equivalent focal length), while its native in-camera zoom has been upgraded from 12x to 15x (300mm equivalent). Tailored for live events, the update adds a dedicated "Stage Mode" and improves low-light tracking for telephoto shots. The Concert Kit, which includes the camera, teleconverter, and a carrying case, is priced at 4,358 RMB.

For portrait and social media creators, the update introduces 4K vertical video, vertical photos, cinematic Live Photos, and beautified Live Photos. Additionally, a new simultaneous recording feature allows users to capture Live Photos during continuous video recording without interruption. Audio capabilities have also been upgraded with two new modes: "Stage Audio" to focus on sound from the stage, and "Venue Audio" to capture ambient crowd noise.

title_zh: Kimi Code Desktop 上线 macOS 和 Windows
content_zh:
月之暗面昨日正式推出 Kimi Code Desktop 1.0，macOS 和 Windows 版已同步上线。这是 Kimi Code 的官方桌面客户端，可在图形界面中让 AI Agent 读写代码、运行命令和完成自动化任务。

客户端会按工作区组织项目和会话，内置终端、浏览器、代码差异审阅与 Git 状态查看。用户可在右侧面板按文件或单轮修改查看差异，也能跟踪当前分支、本地文件变化及关联 PR 的状态。

Kimi Code Desktop 保留了 CLI 任务，并提供 Plan、Goal、Swarm 和实验性 Tower 四种工作模式。Plan 会先生成方案再执行，Goal 适合多轮推进长任务，Swarm 和 Tower 则用于将复杂工程拆给多个子 Agent 并行处理。它支持直接登录 Kimi 账号，也可配置第三方模型供应商。
title_en: Moonshot AI Launches Kimi Code Desktop for macOS and Windows
content_en:
Moonshot AI has officially launched Kimi Code Desktop 1.0, now available on both macOS and Windows. This new graphical user interface (GUI) client enables AI agents to read and write code, execute commands, and automate complex workflows.

The desktop application organizes projects and sessions into workspaces. It features a built-in terminal, an integrated browser, code diff reviews, and Git status tracking. Users can easily monitor branches, local file changes, and pull request statuses directly within the app.

Kimi Code Desktop retains CLI tasks and introduces four distinct operational modes: Plan, Goal, Swarm, and the experimental Tower. While "Plan" drafts a solution before execution, "Goal" is designed for multi-turn long-running tasks. "Swarm" and "Tower" break down complex engineering projects into parallel tasks handled by multiple sub-agents. The client supports direct login via Kimi accounts as well as integration with third-party model providers.

title_zh: 小米 MiMo-V2.6 开源：支持 1M 上下文训练，Agent 能力大幅升级
content_zh:
小米昨日正式发布并开源 Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6 系列，包含 Pro 和 Flash 两款原生全模态模型。

小米称，MiMo-V2.6-Pro 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 中获得 46 分，超过 Kimi K3 和 Qwen3.8 Max，但与 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 等闭源模型仍有差距。

据悉，MiMo-V2.6-Flash 和 Pro 的 Live RL 训练历时不到 6 天，训练成本分别约 85 万美元和 262 万美元，各完成 30 步训练，累计产生约 75 万条轨迹。

训练后，两款模型在 DeepSWE v1.1 上分别提升约 17 分和 14 分。训练单次更新使用 1568 个样本，支持 1M 上下文长度，单步训练 Token 量达到 27 亿至 37 亿。

能力方面，MiMo-V2.6 将多模态感知、3D 空间推理和 Computer Use 能力进一步整合，可用于生成 3D 开放世界游戏、Blender 建模、控制仿真机械臂，以及操作常见办公和生产力软件。

小米同时上线 MiMo Desktop 桌面客户端，其中 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 提供最高 20 倍输出速度的 UltraSpeed 模式。

MiMo-V2.6 系列也已登陆 MiMo 开放平台，API 定价沿用上一代：Pro 常规输入、输出价格分别为每百万 Token 3 元和 6 元，Flash 分别为 1 元和 2 元。
title_en: Xiaomi Open-Sources MiMo-V2.6: 1M Context Support and Upgraded Agent Capabilities
content_en:
Xiaomi has officially released and open-sourced its MiMo-V2.6 series, featuring two native multimodal models: Pro and Flash.

In the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, MiMo-V2.6-Pro scored 46 points, outperforming Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max, though it still trails behind leading closed-source models like Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra. The models underwent Live Reinforcement Learning (RL) training for under six days, costing approximately $850,000 for Flash and $2.62 million for Pro. Both models support a massive 1-million-token context window.

The upgrade significantly boosts the models' capabilities in multimodal perception, 3D spatial reasoning, and computer-use automation. They can be applied to tasks ranging from generating 3D open-world games and Blender modeling to controlling robotic arms and operating standard office software.

Alongside the models, Xiaomi launched the MiMo Desktop client, featuring an "UltraSpeed" mode for the Pro version that delivers up to 20x faster output. The models are also available on the MiMo Open Platform, with API pricing starting at RMB 1 per million input tokens for Flash and RMB 3 for Pro.

title_zh: Grok 4.7 发布：主攻长任务，API 最低 2 美元 / 百万 token
content_zh:
昨日，SpaceXAI 正式发布 Grok 4.7，主攻编程、长时间任务和专业知识工作。目前新模型已进入 Cursor、Grok Build 和 Grok API，并将通过第三方编程工具、模型路由平台及云服务提供。

官方介绍称，Grok 4.7 使用了比 Grok 4.6 更大的新基础模型，并延长强化学习训练时间，重点加强长上下文管理、自我检查，以及持续数小时执行复杂任务的能力。

基准测试中，Grok 4.7 xHigh 在 CursorBench 4.0 上获得 46.3%，高于 Grok 4.6 High 的 40.4%；DeepSWE v1.1 从 65.2% 提升至 71.0%，Terminal-Bench 4.0 则由 20.3% 升至 38.0%。

不过横向比较来看，新模型并未全面领先：CursorBench 4.0 仍低于 Fable 5.1 Max，DeepSWE v1.1 也略低于 GPT-5.6 Sol Max。

价格是此次升级的一大竞争点。Grok 4.7 API 定价与上一代保持一致，每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 6 美元；另有输出速度约翻倍的快速版本，价格同样翻倍。

title_en: xAI Launches Grok 4.7: Optimized for Long-Running Tasks with Competitive API Pricing
content_en:
xAI has officially released Grok 4.7, a new model tailored for coding, long-duration tasks, and professional knowledge work. The model is now accessible via Cursor, Grok Build, the Grok API, and various third-party developer tools and cloud platforms.

Built on a larger foundation model than its predecessor, Grok 4.7 features extended reinforcement learning (RL) training. This enhancement significantly improves its long-context management, self-correction abilities, and capacity to execute complex tasks continuously for hours.

In benchmark tests, Grok 4.7 xHigh demonstrated notable improvements, scoring 46.3% on CursorBench 4.0 and 71.0% on DeepSWE v1.1. While it marks a substantial step up from Grok 4.6, it still trails slightly behind competitors like Fable 5.1 Max and GPT-5.6 Sol Max in certain evaluations.

Pricing remains highly competitive. The Grok 4.7 API is priced at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. A high-speed variant offering double the output velocity is also available at twice the standard rate.
